annotations.title: DNS propagation check: answers from 5 resolvers worldwide

description: Check whether a DNS change has propagated: the same record queried at five public resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, AdGuard, AliDNS and DNSPod), each resolver's answers and TTLs, whether they all agree, and the majority answer. Record types A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA. Use to see where an old value is still cached after changing a record, moving hosting or setting up email; for one lookup use dns_lookup. Example: name=example.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

name.description: Domain name (or a URL; its host is used)

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT or CAA (default A)
